controls, and control testing aligned to frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, and NFR.

optimization and operational efficiency.
Recognized for thriving in high-pressure environments, influencing senior stakeholders, and consistently delivering mission-critical
initiatives on time with strong governance and risk control.
